_doc: OWE BLOCK BRAWL asset manifest. JSON has no comments, so every entry below has a matching note under '_notes'.
sheets: { id: { src, frame:[w,h], spacing, margin, columns, rows } }. A frame index is row*columns + col, counted from 0 at the top-left.
Open tools/atlas.html?sheet=<id> (with a local server) to see every sheet with its frame indices overlaid.
tilesets: { id: { sheet, roles:{ role:[frame,...] }, placeholder:{ role:'#hex' }, pitShade, _notes } }.
When a role lists several frames, a position hash picks one per tile. Roles: floor, wall (brick face, drawn when the tile south of a wall is open),
wallTop (solid mass), cover (solid prop on a floor), pit (void), deco (non-solid floor decal), hazard_* (telegraph markers).
Frames that are not full tiles (cover, deco) are drawn over a floor tile, so transparency is fine.
characters: paper-doll layers drawn bottom to top: body, legs, torso, hair, hat. All layers are 16x16 frames of the 'chars' sheet.
legs / torso / hat are keyed by outfit: red (Crimson Cutters), blue (Seaside Circus), grey (neutral Newcomer), police (Gobbler's sweep).
The sheet ships orange and teal outfits; they stand in for red and blue. 'hair' and 'body' are plain lists of frames to pick from.
icons: { itemId: { sheet, frame } }. Any item without an icon falls back to a placeholder square. Icons are provisional until Stage 4.

held: { itemId: { sheet, frame, rot } } optional in-hand sprite (drawn rotated toward the aim, grip at the bottom-centre of the frame). Falls back to the icon. rot = extra degrees, scale = size multiplier.
anims: optional, empty for now. Future animated sheets: name: { sheet, row, frames, fps }.
Fallback rule: if an image fails to load, or a role or key is missing, a flat rectangle in the role's placeholder colour is drawn.
?placeholders=1 forces placeholders everywhere; the game must stay fully playable that way.

_notes.floor: Tiny Dungeon 48-53: tan sand floor. 48 is plain (listed 2x so plain tiles dominate), 49/51 are pebbled, 50/52/53 have soft edges.
_notes.wall: 40: plain grey brick face (listed 3x). 28: brick with a dark grate slot, used rarely. Drawn on a wall tile whose south neighbour is open.
_notes.wallTop: 0: flat dark brown rock mass (listed 8x). 12: same with rubble, for variety (listed 1 in 9).
_notes.cover: 63 wooden cabinet, 66 clay pot/sack, 82 barrel, 65 grave stone. Solid props on floor.
_notes.pit: 0 (dark rock) darkened by pitShade so a void reads differently from a wall mass.
_notes.deco: 42: grey rubble fragments on a tan floor background, drawn as a non-solid decal. (24 is the same on a dark background, so it is not used on floors.)
_notes.hazard_warn: 61: white hatched square. Used as the cave-in shadow telegraph.
_notes.hazard_mark: 60: white corner-bracket reticle. Marks landing spots.

_notes.floor: Tiny Town roof tiles: flat stone roof (97, 109, 121) and red (52-54, 64-66) / slate (48-50) shingles.
_notes.pit: 39: plain dirt street far below, darkened by pitShade. Falling here costs 15% max HP and a 0.8 s stun.
_notes.floor2: Flat stone roofs (97, 109, 121). Also used for planks and vault ledges so they read as different from shingles.
_notes.pitEdge: 76/77 plaster wall faces: drawn on the alley tile directly south of a roof edge, so a roof reads as a building dropping away.

_notes.floor: Tiny Factory 0-2: orange tan floor plates.
_notes.pit: Dark maroon pit tiles with rubble (9, 11, 32-35).
_notes.conveyor: Belt chevrons by direction: [right 25-27, left 37-39, down (vertical frames drawn flipped) 16/17/28/29, up 16/17/28/29].
_notes.wall: 72/84 grey machine faces, 73 brown crate face: drawn on pipe-maze walls whose south side is open.

_notes.body: 1, 55, 109: three skin tones (with mouth). 0, 54, 108 are the same without a mouth.
_notes.hair: Frames from cols 19-26 of the sheet. Row 0 brown (19-22), row 1 auburn (73,76,77), row 4 blonde (235-237), black (239-241), cream long (289), white (451-452). -1 means bald.
_notes.legs: Col 3: 273 orange (red gang), 219 teal (blue gang), 111 light grey (neutral), 3 dark grey (police).
_notes.torso: 7 orange shirt with belt (red), 11 teal shirt (blue), 282 grey tunic (neutral), 285 dark grey with belt (police).
_notes.hat: 136 orange cap = Cutters red bandana, 190 teal cap = Circus durag, 29 helmet = police. -1 means none.
